history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration enhance oversight of the management of funds, especially regarding the use of a separate interest- bearing bank account, where available, accounting separately for the project expenditures, and inform the third-party auditors of the funds of $7.83 million and take follow-up actions.
history.administration_response: The global guidelines address the use of separate interest-bearing accounts. The Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs verified the relevant bank records, which confirmed that no loss had been incurred, and the availability of supporting documents relating to the $7.83 million. However, the Office will, in the future, ensure that implementing partners maintain proper documentation for audit verifications. We consider this recommendation to be implemented and request that it be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the issue of projects failing to use separate interest-bearing accounts when required was identified, once again, in the audit for the 2024 financial year, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: The Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs is in the process of implementing a system check within the One Grant Management System to capture the availability or unavailability of a separate interest-bearing bank account at the time of project proposal submission. An additional check will also be introduced to indicate whether interest was earned at the conclusion of project implementation. Due to competing priorities and limited resources resulting from ongoing austerity measures and prioritization efforts, a six-month extension is required to complete this work.
